items.question: What meaning is assigned to the oppressed state?
items.inference: The verse states the meaning is oppression.
uncertainties: exact referent of oppression not specified
items.plain_english: It is oppressed; such is the meaning.

items.question: What remains to be said after this point?
items.inference: The remainder is what will be said.
items.plain_english: I will say; thus is the remainder.

items.question: Why is something to be disregarded by the later verse?
premises: uttaraślokena means by the later verse
tadāsāratvāt means because of its worthlessness then
items.inference: The later verse disregards it because of its worthlessness then.
items.plain_english: And by the later verse, because of its worthlessness then, it is to be disregarded.

items.question: What is determined by the statement about the southern course?
premises: dakṣiṇāyanavajīte means conquered by the southern course
ityabhidhānāt means because of the statement
items.inference: The matter is determined by that statement.
items.plain_english: Because of the statement 'conquered by the southern course,' thus it is determined.

items.question: What meaning is given for the act of telling?
premises: ityarthaḥ means such is the meaning
items.inference: The meaning is that he would tell.
items.plain_english: He would tell; such is the meaning.

items.question: How is the earlier pattern to be understood here?
items.inference: As before, it is indeed indicative only.
items.plain_english: As before, it is indeed indicative only.
